properties.description: The “Levante”, a merchant ship owned by “Compagnia Marittima Sarda”, crew of thirteen, destination Tunis.  Along the Sardinian coast it encountered terrible weather, with force 9 seas and 150 km/h gusts of wind.  All 13 crew died.
